verdict.rationale: The REST API covers placing calls through the schedule-call endpoint, with an option to bypass dialing windows, and covers attaching a number by importing a SIP-trunk phone number. The official MCP server exposes Charlie, the built-in assistant that can "build and refine agents", which suggests agent creation is reachable from a coding agent. There is no documented API endpoint for creating agents, and nothing shows the full chain working without the dashboard; API keys themselves are issued in the app's settings. Missing for 10: a documented create-agent API/CLI endpoint, explicit confirmation that MCP/Charlie can create agents and assign numbers, provisioning native telli numbers (not only SIP import), and hands-on corroboration of a fully headless end-to-end flow.
